text:
jordana: Heads-up — CascadeDigital called about an unexpected refund on 2026-01-12. Looks like partner rebate was applied twice across two subscriptions and our system auto-refunded $7,250 to their card. They want the invoice corrected and prefer we avoid a new chargeback. Need approval to either reverse the refund or post a compensating credit memo.

mike_billing: Can you paste the invoice lines and refund trace?

jordana: Snippet (ids masked):

```
Invoice CD-6621
Date: 2026-01-10
Line 5: partner-rebate-CASCADE -$3,625
Line 6: partner-rebate-CASCADE -$3,625  <-- duplicate applied across sub A and sub B due to partner-merge bug
Subtotal adjustments: -$7,250
Auto-refund posted to card: $7,250 (payment-ref: pay-ccd-7781)
```

credits-bot: Heuristic: duplicate-partner-rebate detected (confidence 89%). Suggested actions: 1) open FIN-2026-101, 2) create credit memo CM-CD-202601-GW for $7,250 if we choose courtesy route, 3) else attempt payment reversal with gateway.

elda_partner: Cascade prefers we DO NOT re-charge their card. They want a corrected invoice + ledger offset or a one-time credit on their account. They flagged risk of dispute if funds are pulled back.

ops-bot: Ingestion trace: partner-merge job ran twice for partner id cascade-09 on 2026-01-09 04:12 UTC due to orchestration retry. Trace ids: pm-443 and pm-443-retry. Root cause: missing dedupe token in partner-merge worker.

sam_engineering: We can patch the merge job to add idempotency key and deploy a fix today. I'll also add a reconciliation run to find other partners affected. PR #982 queued.

mike_billing: Recommended path: do NOT reverse funds. Issue a one-time goodwill credit memo CM-CD-202601-GW amount $7,250, mark as "partner_rebate_duplication - courtesy", and attach a corrected invoice INV-CD-6621-CORR. Then recover from partner system if they reimburse us. Approve?

jordana: I support that — less churn for customer. We'll flag recoverable in the vendor ticket and, if Cascade reimburses, we'll reverse the credit later.

credits-bot: Creating credit memo CM-CD-202601-GW (amount: $7,250). Ticket FIN-2026-101 opened to track recovery from partner.

elda_partner: I'll accept the courtesy credit and will coordinate with Cascade billing team to process reimbursement on their side. Please include clear ledger notes so their finance can reconcile.

sam_engineering: Fix merged and canary deployed. Adding monitor PARTNER-MERGE-DUP when same partner-merge job id runs twice within 10 minutes. Backfill found 2 other partners with duplicate rebate rows; adding to FIN-2026-101 for batch adjustment.

mike_billing: Posting the credit now and uploading corrected invoice INV-CD-6621-CORR to customer portal. Payment team will not attempt reversal. We'll record receivable if partner reimburses later.

credits-bot: Actions logged: credit_posted, invoice_corrected, fix_deployed, recovery_ticket_created. FIN-2026-101 updated with affected partners list.

elda_partner: Cascade replied: "Thanks for handling — we prefer the credit. Please send our AP the corrected invoice and ledger details (reference CM-CD-202601-GW)." I've sent the docs.

jordana: Closing loop: credit posted and invoice corrected, engineering deployed fix, recovery ticket open. Reopen FIN-2026-101 if partner reimbursement comes through.

mike_billing: Thanks team. Marking resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
